policy.baselineIsolation: This delta never changes or closes an rc.87 migration case.

files.behavior: The shared browser facade prefers JSON import attributes and falls back to fetch only when loader construction throws SyntaxError; import evaluation and other construction failures do not fetch. The universal server branch imports the supplied asset URL directly. Next emits standard ESM manifest data owned by the bundler. Runtime external hydration uses direct dynamic JSON import attributes without constructing a loader or providing a fetch fallback, and reports import failures as structured diagnostics. Reviewed fixtures use languageVersion 3 and current utility/token syntax.
